entities.name: Mochi
aliases: Mochi, the Smiling Kami of the Crescent Moon
entities.description: Smiling Kami of the Crescent Moon, a powerful diminutive kami who manipulated Toshiro Umezawa.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: Moonfolk whom Mochi secretly worked with.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane the Soratami sought to dominate.

entities.name: Hisoka
entities.description: Aided Konda's quest for immortality alongside the Soratami.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Seeker of immortality and power whose quest began the Kami War.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War begun when Konda gained access to the spirit world.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Defeated O-Kagachi and Konda with Michiko.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Summoned by Michiko and Kyodai, he devoured Mochi.

events.summary: Mochi aided the Soratami and Hisoka in Konda's quest by helping him access the spirit world, beginning the Kami War.
events.quote: this action began the Kami War .

events.summary: Sixteen years later Mochi manipulated Michiko and Toshiro into prolonging the conflict, but their distrust ended his plans.
events.quote: Sixteen years later, he manipulated Princess Michiko Konda and the ronin Toshiro Umezawa into prolonging the conflict

events.summary: Michiko and Kyodai defeated O-Kagachi and Konda.
events.quote: After Michiko and Kyodai defeated O-Kagachi and Konda

events.summary: Michiko and Kyodai summoned Hidetsugu, who devoured Mochi in vengeance for Kobo's death.
events.quote: they in turn summoned Hidetsugu , who devoured him in vengeance for Kobo 's death.
